Carmen: short postmortem follow-up. recurring theme: 5xx/502 noise around deploys + cpu_autoscale alerts thrashing during traffic ramps. propose a small "deploy-aware alert sweep" this sprint: group-by instance, add pod-level grouping option, 8m dedupe window, deploy suppressions, and explicit page labels. owners below.
Leo: I can take the prometheus rule changes and add `group_left` logic to avoid counting transient pod restarts. will target a staging PR by Wed.
Tess: Ill own the paging matrix (night/weekend rules + deploy suppressions) and the `no_page` label convention. drafting policy now, aim to post by Thu.
Mika: runbooks need to reflect the new dedupe and suppression behavior. Ill add examples for how to manually override suppressions during real outages. ETA next Tue.
infra-bot: Automated: pattern analysis: 5xx spikes cluster within 10 min of deploys (last 21 days = 11 events). Top impacted services: gateway, image-pool. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/deploy-5xx-patterns
Leo: sample prometheus alert I plan to use (staging):
```
alert: Service5xxBurst
expr: increase(http_responses_total{status=~"5..",job!="health"}[5m]) > 45
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "8m"
  group_by: "service,instance"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/runbooks/5xx-burst.md"
```
Adding `service` + `instance` grouping and an 8m dedupe should collapse per-pod noise. I'll include a `pod`-level optional grouping param for stateful services.
Tess: paging policy sketch: only page when `severity=critical` OR `for >= 10m`. add `no_page: true` for chatty warnings and `suppress_during: deploy_window` tag for alerts emitted with `deploy_tag` label. also include a nighttime oncall contact matrix (00:00-08:00 -> single pager, 08:00-24:00 -> full rotation).
Mika: for runbooks, I'll add a step to check deploy streams and an override section: `force_page: true` when manual escalation is needed. also include queries to correlate 5xx spikes with `k8s_deploy` events.
Carmen: created GH tracking issue #973 to keep follow-ups in one place: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/973 (checklist added).
infra-bot: Automated: suggested suppression window rule for deploys: match alerts with label `deploy_tag` within +/- 10m of `deployment_timestamp`.
Leo: will add a staging test that synthesizes a single-host 5xx spike and a deploy-correlated spike to validate dedupe and suppression behavior. tagging QA.
Tess: assigning owners & due dates:
- Leo: prometheus rules + staging test (due: Wed COB)
- Tess: paging policy + suppression tags + matrix (due: Thu COB)
- Mika: runbook updates + override docs (due: next Tue)
Carmen: ack all? Ill run a weekly follow-up until closed and add these to the postmortem remediation board. ping me or @pagerduty if blocked. :white_check_mark:
